test_case.test_name: MLPerf Inference v5.0 RetinaNet Offline valid-result comparison
test_case.purpose: Execute one authorized, full-duration MLPerf Inference v5.0 RetinaNet Offline run on the pinned SUT and determine whether its valid Offline throughput meets an owner-approved like-for-like MLCommons comparison threshold.
required_package: Signed MLPerf Inference v5.0 implementation/harness revision and configuration
Authorized RetinaNet model, weights, dataset/calibration assets, checksums and licenses
Pinned SUT hardware, BIOS/power/thermal, OS/kernel, driver, CUDA and container manifest
Matched MLCommons v5.0 system/result, metric, validity policy and numeric acceptance ratio
Approved thermal, power, Xid/ECC/error abort limits and one-run authorization
test_case.test_command: After manifest and safety preflight, run the approved harness once with RetinaNet and Offline selectors equivalent to `make run RUN_ARGS="--benchmarks=retinanet --scenarios=offline"`; collect complete LoadGen accuracy, performance, compliance and validity outputs plus synchronized SUT health, then calculate the declared metric ratio against the approved matched reference.
test_case.expected_result: The pinned RetinaNet Offline workload completes its required formal duration, satisfies the applicable accuracy/validity checks, produces the expected Offline throughput unit, records no configured health abort, and meets the supplied comparison threshold against the explicitly matched v5.0 reference.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires correct RetinaNet+Offline identity, complete non-smoke validity/accuracy evidence, an unchanged pinned SUT, healthy telemetry, a genuinely comparable reference and an approved numeric threshold. BERT output, `training_results_v5.0`, `--test_run`, exit zero alone, a bare score, missing validity logs or `not too far` without a threshold is not PASS. The end engineer decides PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Confirm package hashes/licenses and isolate unrelated workloads before starting.
Verify cooling, power and storage headroom; monitor GPU temperature, power, throttling, Xid/ECC and host errors continuously.
Abort on any owner-defined health limit or lost telemetry and preserve the partial result as invalid.
Do not clear pre-existing evidence and do not automatically retry a failed, invalid or thermally aborted run.
expected_evidence: Harness, configuration, model and dataset/calibration checksums and license record
Exact command plus complete build, accuracy, compliance, performance and LoadGen validity logs
Synchronized GPU/host thermal, power, throttle and error telemetry
Matched reference identity, metric/unit, threshold and reproducible ratio calculation
test_case.recovery: Stop the workload on a validity or health abort, preserve all logs and telemetry, return temporary services/performance settings to the captured baseline, verify GPU/host health, and require a new authorization before any rerun.
